Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 3, Verse 2

“With these seemingly mixed words you are confusing my understanding. Tell me decisively the one path by which I may reach what is best.”

Arjuna asks for a single answer, not a survey. His complaint that the words are mixed drives the rest of the Gita — much of what follows is Krishna showing the two paths are one.
